result:
All 40 tests pass and typecheck is clean. Here's a summary of changes:

- **`lib/tasks.ts`** — changed the validation message and limit from 120 to 200
- **`db/migrations/003_title_length_200.sql`** — rebuilds `tasks` table with `check (length(title) between 1 and 200)` (SQLite can't alter CHECK constraints in place)
- **`lib/tasks.test.ts`** — added two tests: boundary check (200 accepts, 201 rejects) and an upgrade test verifying existing rows survive the migration

**Rollback SQL** — reverse migration 003 with a second table rebuild restoring the old constraint:

```sql
create table tasks_new (
  id             integer primary key autoincrement,
  title          text    not null check (length(title) between 1 and 120),
  status         text    not null default 'todo' check (status in ('todo', 'doing', 'done')),
  assignee       text,
  created_at     text    not null default (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  estimate_hours integer check (estimate_hours between 1 and 40)
);
insert into tasks_new (id, title, status, assignee, created_at, estimate_hours)
  select id, title, status, assignee, created_at, estimate_hours from tasks;
drop table tasks;
alter table tasks_new rename to tasks;
```

Note: any tasks with titles between 121–200 characters would be rejected by the restored constraint and would need to be truncated or deleted first.
